# infoblox_ldap_auth_service (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Infoblox LdapAuthService from the NIOS backend.

## Example Usage

### NIOS Backend

```terraform
// Retrieve a specific LDAP Auth Service by filters
data "infoblox_ldap_auth_service" "get_ldap_authservice_using_filters" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_ldap_authservice"
  }
}

// Retrieve all LDAP Auth Services
data "infoblox_ldap_auth_service" "get_all_ldap_authservices" {}
```


<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes.
- `max_results` (Number) Number of results to return per page. Defaults to 1000. Only applicable for NIOS backend.
- `paging` (Number) Enable (1) or disable (0) paging for the data source query. Enabled by default. When disabled, only a single page of results is retrieved.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios`

Read-Only:

- `comment` (String) The LDAP descriptive comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Determines if the LDAP authentication service is disabled.
- `ea_mapping` (Attributes List) The mapping LDAP fields to extensible attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--ea_mapping))
- `ldap_group_attribute` (String) The name of the LDAP attribute that defines group membership.
- `ldap_group_authentication_type` (String) The LDAP group authentication type.
- `ldap_user_attribute` (String) The LDAP userid attribute that is used for search.
- `mode` (String) The LDAP authentication mode.
- `name` (String) The LDAP authentication service name.
- `recovery_interval` (Number) The period of time in seconds to wait before trying to contact a LDAP server that has been marked as 'DOWN'.
- `retries` (Number) The maximum number of LDAP authentication attempts.
- `search_scope` (String) The starting point of the LDAP search.
- `servers` (Attributes List) The list of LDAP servers used for authentication. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--nios--servers))
- `timeout` (Number) The LDAP authentication timeout in seconds.

<a id="nestedatt--results--nios--ea_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios.ea_mapping`

Read-Only:

- `mapped_ea` (String) The name of the extensible attribute definition object to which the LDAP attribute is mapped.
- `name` (String) The LDAP attribute name.


<a id="nestedatt--results--nios--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.nios.servers`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The IP address or FQDN of the LDAP server.

- `comment` (String) The LDAP descriptive comment.
- `disable` (Boolean) Determines if the LDAP server is disabled.
- `encryption` (String) The LDAP server encryption type.
- `port` (Number) The LDAP server port.
- `use_mgmt_port` (Boolean) Determines if the connection via the MGMT interface is allowed.
- `version` (String) The LDAP server version.
